text: Not all days of the period were checked for thermal detections on this property. While the initial assessment covered the entire period from October 1, 2026, to October 8, 2026, a subsequent review revealed that there were temporal gaps in the data coverage. Specifically, the sensors (MODIS, VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, and VIIRS_NOAA21) did not cover the days October 7, 2026, to October 8, 2026, due to the latest Near Real-Time (NRT) file updates not being published yet. Therefore, the assessment for these days is marked as insufficient evidence.
